brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Japan's corporate services inflation has reached a 2-year high. [1]
Over 1,500 people remain in shelters two months after the Kumamoto earthquake in Japan. [4]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR JAPAN
Japan's high net energy import dependency of 87% makes the corporate services inflation increase particularly concerning for energy-intensive sectors. [1][E4]

KEY RISKS
Japan's 87% net energy import dependency exposes it to supply disruption risks through the Korea Strait chokepoint. [E4][E5]
Japan is linked to 22 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, posing potential diplomatic and economic friction risks. [E3]

WATCH ITEMS
It remains to be seen whether Nissan's business reshaping in Japan will succeed in supporting its global growth push. [3]
